Capabilities

  • Software development: web applications, installable phone apps (PWAs), APIs and PostgreSQL databases; Python, JavaScript and TypeScript, Go.
  • Cloud and hosting: deployment, domains, DNS, business email routing and managed PostgreSQL on free or low-cost tiers.
  • IT consulting: turning a business's own prices and processes into a working system: costing and quoting, booking, record-keeping.
  • Security and data protection: row-level security on every table, secret keys kept out of phone code, data export and erasure designed in, automated checks on every change.
  • Local language, low-cost phones: Sesotho and English interfaces, offline-first apps, light pages for expensive mobile data.
  • Data and automation: pipelines, scheduled jobs and analysis.

How we deliver

  1. Scope in writing: each phase has a written scope and a fixed price, agreed before work starts.
  2. Milestones you can open: delivered to a live address you can check on your phone.
  3. Checked before you see it: automated tests and a check at phone width before each release.
  4. Handover: your domain, your accounts, your data, with written setup and handover notes.

What is different

  • Built in Sesotho and English from the start.
  • Offline-first for low-cost Android phones and expensive data.
  • The person who scopes the work is the person who builds it.
